warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.00 + 4.00 (7.00); y = A-B-C-D at 3.50 + 2.00 + 1.20 (6.70). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01 (both views), S-02, S-03 (both views), A-03, A-07 and A-08. Vector CAD PDF with no text layer — every value read off the rendered page.
Raised single-storey house: S-01 view 2 is the ground-level structure ระดับ ±0.00 (bays marked OPEN, no slabs), S-02 is the raised floor ระดับ +2.35, S-03 the roof ระดับ +5.95 (= ระดับหลังอะเส).

Dummy x lines: 1' -1.00 / 3' 8.00 (S-03 view 2 eave overhangs), 1'' -0.50 (S-02/A-03/A-07 cantilevered strip edge), 1''' 1.40 (S-02/A-03 1.40 + 1.60), 2' 3.38 / 2'' 3.63 (S-03 view 1 ตั้ง posts, chain 0.38 | 0.25 | 3.38 which closes to 7.01, a 0.01 drawing rounding). Dummy y lines: A' -1.00 / D' 7.70 (S-03 eave overhangs), A'' -0.50 (cantilevered strip edge in bay 2-3), A''' 1.00 and A'''' 2.20 (S-02/A-03 inner chain 1.00 | 1.20 | 1.30), A''''' 3.35 (S-03 3.35 | 0.15).

z: ±0.00 = ระดับดินถม (A-07/A-08). The S-02 title level +2.35 (structural floor) and the room-tag levels +2.40 / +2.45 / +2.50 are all recorded; A-03 tags ห้องครัว +2.50 while A-07 tags it +2.45 — architectural finish, not reconciled. ระดับดินเดิม (S-04) and ระดับดิน (S-06) print no value: kept with level_m null; the footing depths 1.00 / 0.25-0.30 / 0.05 / 0.05 stay on the footing elements (S-04 file).

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-06, the floor plan A-03 and the building sections A-07/A-08. The elevations A-05/A-06 reprint the same x/y chains (0.50 | 3.00 | 4.00 = 7.00 and 1.20 | 2.00 | 3.50 | 0.50 = 6.70) and levels; they, A-04 (architectural roof plan, 1.00 overhangs), A-09, A-10, E-01 and SN-01/SN-02 were not transcribed into dimension_chains in this op04 (pass2-only) run. S-04..S-06 print only member-internal dimensions (cap sizes, pile spacing, section sizes, slab/stair thicknesses), which stay on their elements.
